event.summary: Jesus De Miguel, a 30-year-old forward for Tenerife, has died following a collision during a match. The incident occurred when he was struck in the chest while challenging for the ball, leading to a cardiac arrest. His club expressed deep sorrow over the loss.

event_overview.title: About Tenerife Footballer Jesus De Miguel Dies After On-Field Collision
event_overview.subject: Tenerife Footballer Jesus De Miguel Dies After On-Field Collision
event_overview.summary: The event concerns the death of CD Tenerife forward Jesús de Miguel Alameda after an on-field incident during Tenerife’s Spanish second-division match against FC Andorra. The club announced his death on November 3, 2026, and Spanish football bodies issued public condolences and competition-related tributes afterward.

facts.label: Match and location
facts.value: The incident occurred during CD Tenerife’s home LALIGA HYPERMOTION fixture against FC Andorra on November 2, 2026, at Estadio Heliodoro Rodríguez López in Santa Cruz de Tenerife; the official match page records a 2-2 scoreline and identifies it as Matchday 12.

facts.label: Death announcement
facts.value: CD Tenerife announced that Jesús de Miguel Alameda died at 8:00 a.m. on November 3, 2026, and asked for respect for his family’s privacy.

facts.label: Competition context
facts.value: LALIGA HYPERMOTION is Spain’s professional second division and comprises 22 clubs; CD Tenerife and FC Andorra were among its 2026-27 participants.

facts.label: Football authorities’ response
facts.value: The Royal Spanish Football Federation publicly mourned de Miguel’s death and suspended its Copa del Rey and Copa de la Reina activity scheduled for November 3-5 as a mark of respect and solidarity.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers the immediate death, reactions and accounts connected to the match, rather than providing a complete record of medical findings, any investigation, disciplinary process, or all subsequent fixture decisions.
